note: Controlled benchmark population. These distributions are not production incident rates.

oasse_and_transport_overhead_ms.definition: Successful full-pipeline elapsed time minus NeoMundi-reported processing time. This residual includes network transit, serialization, bridge mapping, FAM evaluation, Gatekeeper sealing, and client overhead.

neomundi_audit_population.interpretation: NeoMundi recorded all 1,000 calls in the July 29 run. The 996 successful local artifacts match directly by trace ID prefix. The four remaining audit entries equal the four local timeout rows and are all ALLOW with confidence 1.0 and G-Score 0.6.
neomundi_audit_population.mapping_caveat: The timeout rows do not retain NeoMundi request IDs. Exact one-to-one assignment of the four unpaired audit entries to timeout ordinals is therefore chronological inference rather than a direct identifier join.
